camel_example: aliyun eiam SetApplicationProvisioningConfig --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ProvisionProtocolType idaas_callback
description_en: Sets the account synchronization configuration for an EIAM application
description_zh: 设置一个EIAM应用的账户同步功能配置
kebab_example: aliyun eiam set-application-provisioning-config --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --provision-protocol-type idaas_callback --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetApplicationProvisioningConfig

parameters.help_en:
The account synchronization protocol type. Valid values:
idaas_callback: IDaaS custom event callback-based account synchronization.
scim2: System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol-based synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
账户同步协议类型，取值可选范围：
idaas_callback：IDaaS自定义事件回调账号同步方式。
scim2：SCIM协议同步方式
parameters.name: provision_protocol_type

fields.help_en: The destination URL where the application receives IDaaS event callbacks
fields.help_zh: 应用接收IDaaS事件回调的目标地址
fields.name: callback_url

fields.help_en: The symmetric encryption and decryption key for IDaaS event callbacks. The key uses the AES256 algorithm and is in hexadecimal encoding format
fields.help_zh: IDaaS事件回调对称加解密密钥，AES256算法类型密钥，Hex编码格式
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether IDaaS event callback messages are encrypted. Valid values:
true: Encrypted.
false: Not encrypted. Messages are transmitted in plaintext
fields.help_zh:
IDaaS事件回调消息是否加密，取值可选范围：
true：加密。
false：不加密，明文传递
fields.name: encrypt_required

fields.help_en: The list of IDaaS event callback message types to listen for
fields.help_zh: IDaaS事件回调监听消息类型列表
fields.name: listen_event_scopes

parameters.help_en: The application event callback synchronization configuration. This parameter is required when ProvisionProtocolType is set to idaas_callback
parameters.help_zh: 应用事件回调同步配置，当ProvisionProtocolType为idaas_callback时，必须填写
parameters.name: callback_provisioning_config

fields.help_en:
The authorization pattern for the System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol API. Valid values:
oauth2: OAuth2 pattern
fields.help_zh:
SCIM协议接口授权模式。取值可选范围：
oauth2：OAuth2模式
fields.name: authn_mode

fields.help_en: The access token. This field can be updated when GrantType is set to bearer_token
fields.help_zh: 访问令牌。bearer_token密钥模式时可以更新该字段
fields.name: access_token

fields.help_en:
The System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol authentication pattern. Valid values:
client_secret_basic: Passes the secret through the request header.
client_secret_post: Passes the secret through the request body
fields.help_zh:
SCIM协议认证模式， 返回值包括如下：
client_secret_basic：通过请求Header传递密钥。
client_secret_post：通过请求body传递密钥
fields.name: authn_method

fields.help_en: The client ID of the application
fields.name: client_id

fields.help_en: The client secret of the application
fields.name: client_secret

fields.help_en:
The authorization configuration parameters. Usage:
If GrantType is set to client_credentials, you can update ClientId, ClientSecret, and AuthnMethod.
If GrantType is set to bearer_token, you can update AccessToken
fields.help_zh:
授权相关配置参数。使用方式如下：
当GrantType为client_credentials时， 可以更新ClientId，ClientSecret，AuthnMethod。
当GrantType为bearer_token时，可以更新AccessToken
fields.name: authn_param

fields.help_en:
The System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol authorization pattern. Valid values:
client_credentials: Client credentials pattern.
bearer_token: Bearer token pattern
fields.help_zh:
SCIM协议授权模式。取值可选范围：
client_credentials：客户端模式。
bearer_token：密钥模式
fields.name: grant_type

fields.help_en: The System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol synchronization configuration parameters
fields.help_zh: SCIM协议同步相关配置参数
fields.name: authn_configuration

fields.help_en:
The System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol full push scope. Valid values:
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:PUSH: Full user synchronization
fields.help_zh:
SCIM协议全量推送范围。取值可选范围：
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:PUSH 用户全量同步
fields.name: full_push_scopes

fields.help_en:
The System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol target resource operation actions. Valid values:
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:CREATE: Account creation.
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:UPDATE: Account update.
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:DELETE: Account deletion
fields.help_zh:
SCIM协议目标资源操作行为。取值可选范围：
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:CREATE 账户创建
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:UPDATE 账户更新
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:DELETE 账户删除
fields.name: provisioning_actions

fields.help_en: The base URL where the application accepts IDaaS synchronization requests based on the System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol
fields.help_zh: 应用接受IDaaS同步SCIM协议的Base地址
fields.name: scim_base_url

parameters.help_en: The IDaaS System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol synchronization configuration parameters. This parameter is required when ProvisionProtocolType is set to scim2
parameters.help_zh: IDaaS SCIM协议同步配置参数。当ProvisionProtocolType为scim2时，必须填写
parameters.name: scim_provisioning_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether IDaaS user event callbacks synchronize passwords. Valid values:
true: Passwords are synchronized.
false: Passwords are not synchronized
parameters.help_zh:
IDaaS用户事件回调是否同步密码，取值可选范围：
true：同步密码。
false：不同步密码
parameters.name: provision_password
